ModMetaData.name: Sapient Mechanoids Rewired
ModMetaData.author: Lukinari
ModMetaData.description: Big and Small - Sapient Animals turns a mechanoid into a sapient colonist by building it as a brand new race, only carrying over the things it's been told are safe. It just doesn't know about mech-only gear like a War Queen's steel reserve or urchin release, so those don't come along for the ride. This mod tells it they're safe and fixes the follow-up issues that come with restoring them, so your sapient mechanoids keep working like the real thing. Does nothing unless Big and Small is active.
